Group none

Scans go into the current group. Start a new group for the next box; each group becomes its own tab in the Excel file.

Loading SKU list…

Get the SKU inside the box, reasonably close and without glare. Each read is checked against the SKU list and the product name is shown. "Label: auto" tries upright and sideways in turn; if all your labels face the same way, tap it to pin one orientation and reads get faster.

The number is how many labels of this SKU to add (they all go into the current group).

The SKU list is built in. To use a newer list on this phone, load a CSV or Despatch Cloud export here (SKU and Name columns).

The Excel file has the labels in scan order (one row each, same layout as the label generator), a Summary tab and a Read me tab.

Share opens the phone's share sheet: choose Gmail, WhatsApp, Google Drive or OneDrive to get the file to the laptop. Then open it in Excel and print as usual (font "Jawda Barcode 128" installed, row height 82, column width 27, 45 x 26 mm paper).
